goal: Define abort, forward-recovery, and switch-back boundaries after a protected failover from backend PostgreSQL primary to the existing production Supabase standby.

source_before_failover.label: backend_postgres_primary
source_before_failover.role: normal production read/write primary until approved failover

target_after_failover.label: existing_production_supabase_standby
target_after_failover.role: authoritative provider after approved Supabase standby failover

boundaries.description: Abort is allowed before #502 switches provider mode to Supabase. Backend PostgreSQL is still authoritative, and paused writers may resume only through the writer-pause resume proof.
requires: confirm #502 provider switch did not run
run #526 resume verification before production writers resume
confirm app and worker Supabase writes were never enabled
release or expire the split-brain fence epoch after abort approval
blocked_when: Supabase app or worker writes were enabled

boundaries.description: After #502 switches provider mode to Supabase, the existing production Supabase database is authoritative. Backend PostgreSQL must not resume primary from its old state.
requires: keep backend PostgreSQL fenced from production writes
treat backend PostgreSQL as stale until rebuilt or reconciled from Supabase
run production smoke checks against Supabase provider mode
record owner decision for forward recovery on Supabase
blocked_when: backend PostgreSQL writes are re-enabled without rebuild or reconciliation
split-brain fence cannot prove one write-eligible provider

boundaries.description: Switch-back to backend PostgreSQL is a new protected promotion from authoritative Supabase to a rebuilt or reconciled backend PostgreSQL candidate.
blocked_when: backend PostgreSQL was not rebuilt or reconciled from authoritative Supabase
required-table parity from Supabase to backend PostgreSQL is missing or failing
backend PostgreSQL sequence safety is missing or failing
no-split-brain evidence is missing or failing
writer-pause evidence is missing or failing
owner approval or staging drill evidence is missing

switch_back_gates.purpose: Prove backend PostgreSQL candidate was rebuilt or reconciled from authoritative Supabase after failover.
Prove required-table row counts and checksums match from authoritative Supabase to backend PostgreSQL candidate.
Prove backend PostgreSQL sequences are safe for the next write after Supabase-origin reconciliation.
Prove exactly one provider can be write-eligible before switch-back.
Prove app, worker, scheduler, and admin writers are paused before switch-back.
Record explicit owner approval for switch-back and rollback boundary acceptance.
Record staging rehearsal evidence for failover recovery and switch-back negative paths.

validation.live_status: accepted boundary definition only; switch-back remains blocked until backend PostgreSQL is rebuilt or reconciled from authoritative Supabase, parity passes, sequence safety passes, no-split-brain evidence passes, writer pause passes, staging drill evidence is recorded, and owner approval is attached
